title: Delivery tracking: failures are shown now, but no delivered / read status per recipient
date: TAVI 9 Nov 2026 (NDC-Staging app texts) · NDC-1851 item 6

panels.caption: What a sent reply can show (app texts, 9 Nov 2026)
text: Conversation: "To {{recipients}}", "Not delivered: {{reason}}", "Not delivered. The recipient's mail server refused it."
New notification rule: "An email to the customer is not delivered" (tells the agent and the ticket owner).
No text for delivered, opened or read per recipient.

panels.caption: Requirement (NDC-1851 item 6, Phase 3)
text: Read receipts and delivery status for each recipient of a reply.

rows.tavi: Failed or bounced replies are marked "Not delivered" with the reason and can notify the agent; no delivered or read status

notes: Not seen on a real sent reply: the throwaway ticket's department has no email channel, and the composer refused qa.rt2636@example.com as "not a valid email address".
